enable_binding_cookie.gate: Check fresh login, logout and multiple browsers before retaining this setting

access.method: Read current app, preserve unrelated configuration and policies, update only reviewed cookie fields with Access application PUT, then read back

tls.scope: Zone-wide, including other proxied sites in this zone
tls.hostnameOverrideRead: 404 Resource not found; availability not established
tls.verification: TLS 1.0 and 1.1 fail; TLS 1.2 and 1.3 connect; current owner browsers can sign in
tls.rollback: Preserve existing setting and review compatibility failure before rollback; do not silently restore weak protocols
